intro: Kadrak's Flag is an emblem of the Horde given by the scout Kadrak at the border between the Barrens and Ashenvale. It serves as an unmistakable warning to the night elves and dryads of Stonetalon Peak, planted directly in the Talon Den after the elimination of Keymaster Rynthariel.

p: Tensions run high along the borders of Kalimdor, where Alliance messengers and sentinels routinely test the boundaries of Horde-held territories. When a decoded scroll reveals communications from the dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den, Kadrak determines that killing her is not enough. He provides this crimson banner to be planted deep within the Den upon the peak of Stonetalon. By staking the Horde's colors inside one of the night elves' sacred mountain redoubts, Kadrak intends to send a clear message: incursions across the Barrens will be answered with bold retaliation on Alliance soil.
